title: About me
summary: Full-stack Web Developer and System Analyst with a strong Computer Engineering foundation (GPAX 3.91) and experience working across government agencies, universities, enterprises, and startups. Proficient in user requirement analysis, translating business requirements into system architecture design, data models (ERD), and API specifications, as well as full-stack web development (especially with Next.js and Express.js) and SDLC methodologies. My past work focuses on developing management systems that drive digital transformation and improve operational efficiency. Passionate about leveraging robust code and system design to build high-impact, user-centric products.
